case.summary: Case HHG-020 was opened after transaction 3509359 for $125.08 triggered a risk score of 0.52. The transaction was conducted online using a new device profile on Windows 10 that had not been seen on card C12265-K2 before. Despite the new device, a secondary classifier scored the transaction at 0.01, and the final fraud probability was determined to be 0.04. Following Policy 6, the transaction was allowed and the case closed as legitimate because the probability was below 0.15 on two independent signals.
